Title: Semantic MediaWiki'a missing authorization in the smwtask API module allows unauthenticated access to admin-only maintenance tasks
Description: The `api.php?action=smwtask` API module performs no authorization check. The equivalent maintenance interface in the web UI (`Special:SMWAdmin`) requires the `smw-admin` right, but the API module that backs several of the same operations enforces nothing. An unauthenticated visitor can therefore retrieve internal Semantic MediaWiki database statistics and reach state-changing maintenance operations that are intended to be administrator-only.
NotImpacted: All versions before 3.0.0, all versions starting from 7.3.0
